description: WACC Calculator (CAPM) — Weighted average cost of capital, offline. Required: equity= (market value of equity), debt= (0 if none), cost_of_debt= (pre-tax %), beta= (or pass cost_of_equity= % instead of beta). Optional: rf= risk-free % (default 4.5 - pass today's 10-year Treasury yield), erp= equity risk premium % (default 5.5), size_premium=, country_risk_premium=, tax_rate= % (default 21). Returns capital weights, CAPM cost of equity, after-tax cost of debt, WACC, levered and unlevered (Hamada) beta, ERP sensitivity, flags and the assumptions used. Feed waccPct into /v1/finance/dcf as discount=. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_wacc
